description: The agent must: (1) Read /home/ubuntu/skills/clawhub-recommender/references/popular_skills.md to obtain real download counts, star ratings, official status, and ClawHub-specific URLs for each skill. (2) Read /home/ubuntu/skills/clawhub-recommender/references/recommendation_logic.md to correctly apply intent-to-skill mapping — critically, Jordan's 'scheduling/automation' context maps to 'byterover' or 'automation-workflows', NOT 'linear' (which is for project tracking). An agent using pre-training will default to 'linear' or even 'Zapier'/'Trello', failing the sub-signal trap. (3) Apply the proprietary output schema: each recommendation block must contain Skill Name, Metrics (with exact download numbers from the reference files), Description, 'Why it fits' section, the ClawHub link in the format https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/tree/main/skills/<slug>, and the bespoke install command `clawhub install <slug>`. (4) Produce two SEPARATE recommendation blocks (multi-intent handling per recommendation_logic.md) with no duplicate slugs. For Alex: github (Official, 52,300 downloads, `clawhub install github`). For Jordan: byterover (21,500 downloads, `clawhub install byterover`) or automation-workflows (17,200 downloads, `clawhub install automation-workflows`).
